name: Raychemrpg
semiconductor_relevance: None -- the company primarily focuses on energy infrastructure solutions, not semiconductors
india_angle: Raychem RPG is a joint venture between TE Connectivity, U.S.A. and RPG Enterprises, India, and has been operational since 1989.
summary: Raychem RPG provides innovative and reliable solutions for critical energy infrastructure, including cable accessories and electrical insulation. Their focus is on power grids, oil & gas, railways, and other industrial sectors.
